previous_statement: Base j=1 is the identity. For j>=2, node 1.1 and node 1.2 give S_{P_[1,j],Q} linearly bijective to S_{P_[1,j-1],Q} direct-sum S_{P_j,Q}; finite induction and P_[1,p]=v(I_B) give S_{P,Q}->direct-sum_j S_{P_j,Q}.
new_statement: Base j=1 is the identity. For each j>=2, a direct two-block compression argument with R_0=P_[1,j-1], R_1=P_j, R=P_[1,j], and T=Q gives a bounded linear bijection S_{R,T}->S_{R_0,T} direct-sum S_{R_1,T}; finite induction and P_[1,p]=v(I_B) then give S_{P,Q}->direct-sum_j S_{P_j,Q}.
